hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Clanker token launchpad that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on a volatility accumulator derived from tick movement across swaps. Collects a configurable protocol fee on each swap of the paired (non-Clanker) token via before/afterSwap delta manipulation, and supports an optional MEV-protection module and pool extension.
